mt: 'ENCYCLOPEDIA OF ANTI-REVISIONISM ON-LINE' ON THE OVERVIEW — THE ENCYCLOPEDIA AT ITS GRAIN; ITS RECORD OF THE NEW COMMUNIST MOVEMENT'S SPLITS AND COLLAPSE NOT CARRIED
d: THE ENCYCLOPEDIA, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'The Encyclopedia of Anti-Revisionism On-Line (EROL) is a digital archive developed by the Marxists Internet Archive containing primary source documents, translations, and organizational records from the international anti-revisionist and Marxist-Leninist/Maoist movements.' Core definition; timeframe 1946 to 1983; geographic coverage; periodicals. Five cards: three Marxists Internet Archive pages, Harvard University, one more MIA page.
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked for the encyclopedia, the Overview defines its subject, gives its period and countries, names periodicals and points to its index.
findings: THE SCOPE AT ITS GRAIN. Definition, period, countries and periodicals are carried from EROL's own pages, with the split between Chinese and Albanian alignments.

THE SPLITS NOT CARRIED. EROL's United States section is periodized by its crises: 'The New Communist Movement: Crises, Splits and More New Parties, 1977-1980', 'Anti-Dogmatists Unable to Unite, 1978-1980', 'Collapse and Aftermath'. The composition gives the movement as a country entry. #1725 reads EROL as a record kept of a movement's failure to hold its own critiques, organized by that failure.
analysis: Faithful to the encyclopedia's subject and range. The feature that makes EROL a record of the left's internal history, its periodization by splits, unity attempts and collapse, is not in the composition.
per_note: The MIA named as its host; EROL's own pages cited.
